title: Car Rental Rate Classes: Fuel Arrangement and Fuel Amounts
content:
The fuel arrangement is a published attribute of the class booked on the Car Rental Rate Classes, and two amounts stand beside it.

| Rate class | Fuel arrangement | Prepaid fuel per gallon (USD) | Refuelling service charge (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pay Now Saver Rate | full to full | 5.49 | 35.00 |
| Pay Now Standard Rate | full to full | 5.49 | 32.00 |
| Pay At Counter Flex Rate | full to full | 5.29 | 29.00 |
| Inclusive Flex Rate | same to same | 5.29 | 25.00 |
| Premium Inclusive Rate | prepaid | 4.99 | 0.00 |
| Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate | full to full | 4.89 | 22.00 |

The arrangement column takes one of three published values: full to full, prepaid, or same to same. The price per gallon is the price where fuel is bought in advance from the supplier. The refuelling service charge is the service charge added when the supplier has to refuel the vehicle.

**Distinguishing the classes.** Four classes are full to full: the Pay Now Saver Rate, the Pay Now Standard Rate, the Pay At Counter Flex Rate and the Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate. The Inclusive Flex Rate is same to same, and the Premium Inclusive Rate is prepaid. The price per gallon runs 5.49 on the two Pay Now classes, 5.29 on the Pay At Counter Flex Rate and the Inclusive Flex Rate, 4.99 on the Premium Inclusive Rate and 4.89 on the Corporate Negotiated Drive Rate. The refuelling service charge runs 35, 32, 29, 25, 0 and 22 in the order of the table.
